label: M6.4 Long Beach earthquake
Notes: School buildings collapsed across the region. Led to the Field Act requiring engineered and state-supervised public school construction and the Riley Act mandating local building departments and lateral-force design.

label: M6.6 San Fernando (Sylmar) earthquake
Notes: Hospital and freeway failures led to the Hospital Seismic Safety Act (1972) and the Alquist-Priolo fault-zoning act. A major driver of modern California seismic code development.

label: M6.9 Loma Prieta earthquake
Notes: Cypress Street Viaduct and Bay Bridge failures accelerated Caltrans' statewide bridge seismic retrofit program and Bay Area building retrofit activity.

label: M6.7 Northridge earthquake
Notes: Widespread brittle fractures in welded steel moment-frame connections led to the SAC Steel Project and FEMA 350 design guidance and a large retrofit workload for structural engineers.
